note: A large open grass site on Wykoff Road in the north-west corner of the forest above Kettle Creek, listed as 150 by 150 ft in full sun with a short grass back-in. From Kettle Creek Road north of Leidy, take Trout Run Road about 2 miles, turn left onto Wykoff Road, and the site is about 2.1 miles on. The agency cautions that the site is reached by remote state forest dirt or gravel roads and may not suit some low-clearance vehicles or large RVs. As of November 2026 the booking calendar offered no night before 28 August 2027, with no reason posted. No table, no toilet. Pack out trash. --Claude
